title: Palo Alto / Cortex XSOAR Consultant
description:
If interested, please share your resume at: pragathi.thalur@2iresourcing.ca



We are seeking a senior-level Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR Cybersecurity consultant for a 1-year remote contract position in Canada for a large full-cycle implementation project.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Design, build, implement, and maintain automation workflows and playbooks within Cortex XSOAR to respond to security incidents. This includes use cases for incident triage, enrichment, and remediation, such as phishing response and threat intelligence.
  • Help to lead and guide the full cycle implementation of XSOAR as a senior-level consultant.
  • Integrate Cortex XSOAR with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, firewalls, and ticketing systems.
  • Automate and streamline incident response processes to reduce response times and handle a higher volume of alerts. This includes monitoring for security breaches and automating containment actions.
  • Write and maintain custom scripts for custom integrations and playbook development.
  • Work closely with Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts, incident responders, and other IT teams to identify automation opportunities and improve workflows.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of deployed automation, refine playbooks, and troubleshoot issues to ensure the platform operates efficiently.
  • Create technical documentation for playbooks and workflows. Conduct training for internal teams on using the platform.

Key qualifications and skills:

  • Proven, hands-on implementation experience with Cortex XSOAR as a senior or architect-level consultant.
  • A strong background in cybersecurity, including incident response, threat detection, and a solid understanding of security principles, protocols, and technologies.
  • Familiarity with Linux or Unix operating systems, networking fundamentals, and security tools such as IDS/IPS, SIEM, and endpoint solutions.
  • Experience working with REST APIs to integrate different security products and applications.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to design effective automation solutions and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Excellent communication skills to interact with both technical and non-technical audiences, from analysts to executives.
  • Certifications such as Palo Alto Networks Certified Security Automation Engineer (PCSAE) or other relevant credentials like CISSP or CEH are a plus
